title: New experience and an earlier image
meaning: Your shared view can grow richer through new experience even when changed conditions require releasing an earlier image of the whole.
text: New substance sometimes appears alongside regret for a familiar picture. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Ajna suggests updating your view when conditions change. The Empress in energy supports wanting understanding to grow from new observations. Death in emotions experiences farewell to an earlier image of the whole. You may find changed appearances interesting while still treasuring the previous impression. Your shared view gains material for development while retaining the ability to name which part of a familiar image no longer matches the changed arrangement.

For example, you examine a courtyard after its paths have been renewed. The earlier picture of a quiet green corner no longer describes the entire view. **New understanding can grow beside farewell to an old image.** You notice changed lines and connect entrances, trees and open space differently. The picture gains substance. Yet you miss the familiar outline of the earlier path. You can see a new connection without immediately having to love it. An old impression remains part of memory while ceasing to describe the present space completely.

The risk is treating regret as proof that new observations add nothing valuable. Emotional farewell delays updating your view. Wanting understanding to grow preserves both layers: an earlier image can remain dear while a changed space already needs a substantial explanation of its own.
